 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order

This matter was adjourned on 1.09.2023 with a specific observation that the appeal will be
dismissed in case the Court fee is not paid.
Sri.Veeresh R. Budihal, the learned couns
el for the appellant seeks short accommodation to pay the deficit Court fee.
This court does not find any grounds to adjourn the matter as more than three years have elapsed since the appeal is filed.
Appeal is dismissed for non prosecution.
